title: Transaction with Explicit ROLLBACK
description: Write a transaction that inserts a new order and rolls back if stock is insufficient.

data.text: Write a transaction that inserts a new order into the Orders table and inserts order details into OrderDetails. Roll back the entire transaction if any product has insufficient stock.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: BEGIN TRY/BEGIN CATCH handles errors gracefully. @@TRANCOUNT checks if a transaction is still open before rolling back. SCOPE_IDENTITY() gets the last identity value inserted in the current scope. THROW re-raises the error after cleanup. Always check business conditions (stock) inside the transaction.
